info.title: GitHub MCP REST API
info.description: REST data plane for GitHub (github.com): repositories, files, commits, issues, pull requests and search, plus the signed-off writes. Reads exist so a shell-capable client can curl | jq bulk payloads without them crossing the LLM context window; every read also accepts format=text for the same rendering the MCP tool returns. Every request is validated with the MCP tools own Zod schemas and calls the same request builders, so the two surfaces cannot drift. Lists answer {items, page} where page.next is the page to request next. A GitHub rate limit answers 429 with Retry-After, and a rejected stored GitHub credential answers 502, never 401 (a 401 here means your bearer). WRITES accept the permanent dashboard API key as well as the 5-minute bearer, so that key can commit files and merge pull requests on every repository the connected account can write to.

get.description: Answers {total_count, incomplete_results, items, page}. GitHub search returns at most 1000 results and has its own small rate budget; a used-up limit answers 429 with Retry-After. Mirrors the MCP tool `searchRepositories`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: GitHub repository search query, e.g. "mcp language:typescript stars:>100" or "org:github topic:cli". See GitHub search syntax.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Every list response says which page to ask for next.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Results per page, 1–100 (GitHub's default is 30).

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: text returns the MCP tool rendering instead of JSON.

400.description: Rejected by the MCP tool schema, or refused by the op before any call to GitHub

403.description: No GitHub connection, or GitHub refused (permission, SAML SSO, missing scope or fine-grained permission — the message names which)

404.description: Does not exist OR the connected account cannot see it (GitHub answers 404 for both)

502.description: GitHub rejected the stored credential (reconnect), GitHub errored, or it could not be reached

get.summary: Read a file or list a directory
get.description: Raw GitHub contents payload: a file carries base64 content and its blob sha, a directory is an array. Omit the path for the repository root. Takes ?ref and ?format=text. Mirrors the MCP tool `getFileContents`.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Repository owner — a user or organization login, e.g. "octocat" (the part after github.com/).

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Repository name without the owner, e.g. "hello-world".

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Repository-relative file path; slashes are kept, e.g. src/index.ts. For the GET, omit the segment entirely (…/contents) to list the repository root.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Branch, tag or commit SHA to read from. Defaults to the repository's default branch.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: text returns the MCP tool rendering instead of JSON.

post.summary: Create or replace one file as a commit
post.description: Exposed with explicit sign-off: the permanent dashboard API key can commit code. Body limit 5mb. Pass sha (from the GET) to get 409 instead of overwriting a file that changed. 201 created, 200 updated. Mirrors the MCP tool `createOrUpdateFile`.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Repository owner — a user or organization login, e.g. "octocat" (the part after github.com/).

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Repository name without the owner, e.g. "hello-world".

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Repository-relative file path; slashes are kept, e.g. src/index.ts. For the GET, omit the segment entirely (…/contents) to list the repository root.

content.description: The complete new file content, as plain text. Replaces the whole file.

branch.description: Branch to commit to. It must already exist (see createBranch).

sha.description: Blob SHA of the file being replaced, from getFileContents. Pass it to make the write fail if the file changed since you read it; omit it to overwrite whatever is there.

409.description: Conflict: the branch moved, the file changed since its sha, or GitHub answered merged false

get.summary: Get check runs and commit statuses for a pull request
get.description: Answers {headSha, verdict, failing, pending, statuses, checkRuns, checkRunsError, unread}. verdict reads Actions check runs too; checkRunsError is set when the token cannot read them (a fine-grained token needs Checks read). verdict is passing only when every check was read: unread checks past the first page, or unreadable check runs, answer unknown. Mirrors the MCP tool `getPullRequestStatus`.

post.summary: Commit several files to a branch in one commit
post.description: Exposed with explicit sign-off: the permanent dashboard API key can commit code to any repository the account can write to. Body limit 5mb. Fast-forward only: 409 when the branch moved meanwhile, and nothing is pushed. 201 when committed, 200 with pushed false when nothing changed. Cannot write .github/workflows. Mirrors the MCP tool `pushFiles`.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Repository owner — a user or organization login, e.g. "octocat" (the part after github.com/).

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Repository name without the owner, e.g. "hello-world".

branch.description: Existing branch to commit to, e.g. "main" or "feature/x". Create it first with createBranch if needed.

content.description: Complete UTF-8 text content of the file.

files.description: Files to add or replace in one commit (1–100). Each replaces the whole file.

post.description: Exposed with explicit sign-off: effectively irreversible. Pass expectedHeadSha to refuse a merge of commits pushed after review. 200 when merged, 409 when GitHub answered merged false, 405 when not mergeable. Mirrors the MCP tool `mergePullRequest`.
